title: Understanding the Model
text: The model uses a linear regression approach with features for vegetables and types of meat. Adding a random feature can affect the model's variance.

title: Effect of Random Features
text: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ introduces noise. This can increase the model's complexity without adding meaningful information.

title: Variance and Bias
text: Increasing the number of features, especially random ones, typically increases the model's variance. It can lead to overfitting, where the model captures noise instead of the underlying pattern.
